extraction_notes: DSK12 is the 20 V member of the shared DSK12 through DSK120 family; the p. 2 forward curve uses the shared DSK12-DSK14 solid trace, and the reverse curves use the shared DSK12-DSK16 solid trace.

The reverse-current table value is a maximum rating at the rated DC blocking voltage, not a typical value. The 25 °C and 100 °C plotted reverse traces are typical curves and are kept as separate temperature series.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage/current characteristic for DSK12; VRRM/VDC = 20 V is a maximum operating rating and is not treated as breakdown voltage.
omission_reason: Reverse recovery and breakdown characteristics are not published in the supplied datasheet, so those fields are null; all included curve points are digitized readings from real plotted traces on p. 2.
